title: ConsentChannelCategoryWrite
description: Represents a request to configure a consent channel category.

channel.description:
The channel

Members:

  • Email - Email
  • Mail - Mail
  • SMS - SMS
  • Phone - Phone
  • AutoPhone - AutoPhone
  • Social - Social media
  • DataProcessing - Data processing
  • Other - Other

category.description: The category name or system identifier

solicit_code_assignments.description: Collection of consent solicit code assignments to be configured for the channel category.

response.description:
The consent response that will trigger this solicit code assignment

Members:

  • OptIn - Opt-in
  • OptOut - Opt-out
  • NoResponse - No response

add_remove.description:
Add/Remove the solicit code when the given consent response is received.

Members:

  • Add - Add.
  • Remove - Remove.

sequence.description: Optional sequence number for the solicit code assignment.

ConsentSolicitCodeAssignmentWrite.description: Represents a request to write a consent solicit code assignment.
